prompt_head:
Job: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
- (required) Professional experience building and deploying production-grad

paragraphs.text: I see the Forward Deployed Engineer role asks for production‑grade AI‑agent platforms. I have spent four years engineering full‑stack systems that move from concept to cloud deployment, and I built an AI demo generator that runs on edge infrastructure.

At tycodes.app I built a pipeline that turns a business URL into a shoppable 3D demo in about one minute. The pipeline runs on Cloudflare Workers and Workflows and follows six stages, intake, collect, brief, config, verify, publish, using an automated verification step that blocks unsupported pricing claims. The verification stage removes hallucinated pricing and claims before publishing. I also created the linkme‑intops module with React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, providing a dedicated UI for high‑value subscription accounts and delivering integration blueprints that let enterprise clients onboard quickly. The tool reduced service delivery time by over 30 percent for VIP workflows. At Fairman & Associates I built database‑layer validation pipelines that eliminated 98 percent of invoicing errors and reduced manual processing overhead by 68 percent. These systems run in production and include monitoring and cost caps.

One gap is deep experience with graph‑based orchestration and state‑machine patterns. I will study TribalScale’s orchestration framework, run the official tutorials, and build a small graph‑driven prototype that connects my existing edge agents to a state machine controller. This will give me hands‑on practice before contributing to client projects. I will also pair with a senior engineer to review my prototypes and adopt best practices.
I would welcome a conversation to discuss how my edge‑focused AI pipelines and client delivery experience can support TribalScale’s projects.
